hints.title: WELCOME, MINER!
hints.text: Use the arrow keys (or the on-screen D-pad) to move. Head right to start your dig.

hints.title: DIGGING
hints.text: Walk into brown earth to dig a tunnel straight through it.

hints.title: ELEMENTS
hints.text: Collect the glowing elements - the chemical elements that everyday technology is built from. The STATUS panel counts them.

hints.title: SOLID ROCK
hints.text: Gray rock and walls can't be dug - not even blasted. Find a way around: try heading west.

hints.title: RICH EARTH
hints.text: Golden, sparkling rich earth marks mineral-laden ground - treasure is often close by.

hints.title: ON THE CLOCK
hints.text: Watch the ⏰ timer in the STATUS panel - finishing fast means a better score.

hints.title: EXIT HATCH
hints.text: The exit opens only once ALL elements are collected. Missing one? Backtrack - something still glints nearby.
